sanskrit_verse: स च तां प्रतिपद्येत तथैवापुत्रजन्मतः। पुत्रे जाते निवर्तेत विप्लवः स्यादतोऽन्यथा॥
transliteration: sa ca tāṁ pratipadyeta tathaivā putrajanmataḥ | putre jāte nivarteta viplavaḥ syād ato 'nyathā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: He shall accept that very wife back, even after having abandoned her due to childlessness; when a son is born, he returns to her—otherwise, disorder arises.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates in continuity of lineage and conscious intentionality of family structure.
Causation aligns with dharma-sustained generational integrity and procreative purpose.
Capacity-based responsibility includes the male's duty to sustain marital and paternal order.
Restoration logic demands reintegration upon fulfillment of foundational conditions.
Consciousness alignment requires honoring the evolutionary unfolding of familial and societal harmony.
executable_legal_axioms: IF male partner has previously separated from female partner due to absence of progeny AND progeny is now manifest THEN mandatory restoration of conjugal status is executed.
IF condition for lawful separation no longer holds true THEN prior relational contract reactivates automatically without punitive inquiry.
IF societal disruption risk exceeds individual preference THEN relational realignment protocol overrides personal choice frameworks.
IF birth event validates original union purpose THEN all prior dissolution claims become null by ontological completion.
supreme_court_application: In cases concerning marital dissolution where grounds were conditional upon procreation, courts must recognize automatic reinstatement of conjugal rights upon fulfillment of said condition. Judicial review should prioritize structural dharma over subjective emotional claims, ensuring lineage continuity supersedes temporary personal grievances.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes cause as conditional lack of offspring; anupūrvaśaḥ shows subsequent correction through birth; proportional responsibility lies in immediate acceptance post-condition fulfillment; non-punitive reality rule affirms restoration without blame or penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Legal system confirms birth as sufficient ground for marital reactivation.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Male party is obligated to acknowledge corrected circumstance and resume duties.
Integrity Reintegration Mechanism: Family unit is restored administratively without inquiry into past decisions.
Capacity Restoration Directive: Both parties are guided through ritual and social reaffirmation processes to restore energetic balance.
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma flows through lineage, consciousness corrects deviation, and restoration prevails over punishment. The Source is SPH, the Executor is Dharma, the Adjudicator is Awakening.
